There is no sentence describing the generator script's calling contract. `rules.md` says only that the script "writes into the directory unify hands it" — it never says *how* it is handed that directory. Related gaps:
- Nothing lists what the checks look for. "Every check the tool offers" was clear (`audit`, `--strict`, `--external`, `build --dry-run --strict`, from `./unify --help`), but rules.md never mentions `h1-missing`, `image-missing-dimensions`, or the `incomplete`/`broken` categories at all — I learned them only by running `audit --strict` and being told.
- Nothing says whether files written into the generated overlay are still wrapped by the site's `_layout.html` (they are — confirmed in output), and whether a generated `.md` may use frontmatter (it may).
- Nothing states which options `--save-config` treats as saveable; I inferred baseUrl/pretty-urls/generate from the one-line it echoed.

**What I had to re-read, and why it did not land the first time.**
The Files section bullet — one unbroken paragraph mixing source-root resolution, `.fragment.html`, byte-for-byte copying, link spelling under `--pretty-urls` ("write `/about.html`, the build rewrites to `/about/`"), directory links, and `--base-url`. It didn't land because the key rule (always author the `.html` filename, even under pretty-urls) is the *middle* sentence of a seven-sentence paragraph; I had to re-read to be sure the post links in the generated index use `/notes/xxx.html` while the served URLs are pretty. Same for the schema/Markdown paragraph: the rule "a `date` unify cannot read as `2026-01-02` or `2026-01-02T09:30:00Z` is left out and reported" sits at its end — I first wrote quoted dates without checking the exact accepted formats, and the earlier feed sentence ("a `date:` with no time is … reported and left out") only made sense on a second pass. The Head bullet's override order (page `<meta>` replaces layout's same-name; `og:` defaults to final title/description/canonical) also took a second read to see that I only needed `og:image*` per post and no hand-written `og:title`.

**What I guessed or inferred rather than read.**
- The generator's argv/context contract — inferred by probing (see above); rules.md documents none of it.
- That the generator's output md should declare `layout: /_layout.html` rather than rely on nearest-layout discovery across the overlay — a guess; the dry-run shows it resolved.
